mapper.sql: b.id, b.author_id, a.display_name AS scholar_name, b.file_name, b.sheet_name, b.import_mode, b.total_rows, b.imported_count, b.linked_count, b.skipped_count, b.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM author_import_batch b JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE request_key = #{requestKey}
SELECT FROM author_import_batch b JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT display_name FROM author WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT author_id FROM author_import_person WHERE identity_key = #{key}
SELECT id FROM organization WHERE display_name = #{name} ORDER BY id LIMIT 2
SELECT id FROM venue WHERE display_name = #{name} ORDER BY id LIMIT 2
SELECT id FROM subject WHERE source_id IS NULL AND external_id = #{key}
SELECT achievement_id FROM author_import_work WHERE identity_key = #{key}
SELECT id FROM achievement WHERE doi_normalized = #{doi}
SELECT achievement_type FROM achievement WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT a.id FROM achievement_author r JOIN author a ON a.id = r.author_id WHERE r.achievement_id = #{workId} AND a.display_name = #{name} ORDER BY a.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM achievement_advisor WHERE achievement_id = #{workId} AND advisor_id = #{authorId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM author_import_affiliation WHERE achievement_id = #{workId} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND organization_id = #{orgId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO achievement (title_original, title_normalized, match_fingerprint, achievement_type, publication_date, date_precision, doi_normalized, primary_venue_id, first_seen_at, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{row.title}, #{normalizedTitle}, #{key}, #{row.type}, #{row.publicationDate}, #{row.datePrecision}, #{row.doi}, #{venueId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
INSERT INTO paper_detail (achievement_id, abstract_text, authorships_may_be_incomplete) VALUES (#{id}, #{text}, #{incomplete})
INSERT INTO achievement_author (achievement_id, author_id, author_position) VALUES (#{workId}, #{authorId}, #{position})
INSERT INTO achievement_subject (achievement_id, subject_id, subject_position) VALUES (#{workId}, #{subjectId}, #{position})
INSERT INTO author_import_affiliation (achievement_id, author_id, organization_id) VALUES (#{workId}, #{authorId}, #{orgId})
INSERT INTO author_import_batch (request_key, author_id, file_name, sheet_name, import_mode, total_rows) VALUES (#{key}, #{authorId}, #{fileName}, #{sheetName}, #{options.mode}, #{total})
mapper.update: UPDATE author_import_batch SET imported_count = #{imported}, linked_count = #{linked}, skipped_count = #{skipped} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO author_import_record (batch_id, source_row, achievement_id, original_columns) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{rowNumber}, #{workId}, #{original})
mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS batchId, b.file_name AS fileName, b.sheet_name AS sheetName, b.import_mode AS importMode, a.display_name AS scholarName, r.source_row AS rowNumber, CAST(r.original_columns AS CHAR) AS originalColumns FROM author_import_record r JOIN author_import_batch b ON b.id = r.batch_id JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE r.achievement_id = #{achievementId} ORDER BY b.id DESC, r.source_row LIMIT 50
